comment: The optional skin collection. Each entry becomes one player download (a ZIP with the importable skin folder and nothing else). Sources stay in this repository; the ZIPs carry only what a player needs.

packs.title: Rainbow Paint (3D)
packs.blurb: The game's rainbow paint on a rendered 3D tank: red at the top of every part, violet at the bottom.
packs.credit: Rendered from the "TankTrouble in 3D" Blender model by asger-finding (CC0 1.0), with the material, lighting, effect artwork and build tooling by Bleed.

packs.title: Onyx Paint (3D)
packs.blurb: Polished black onyx with thin grey-gold veins, glossy highlights and soft moving tread bands.
packs.credit: Rendered from the "TankTrouble in 3D" Blender model by asger-finding (CC0 1.0), with the onyx material, lighting, effect artwork and build tooling by Bleed.

packs.title: Backer Paint (3D)
packs.blurb: The game's green Backer camouflage as a rendered 3D tank: emerald and forest-green patches that wrap over the dome and barrel, with soft moving tread bands.
packs.credit: Rendered from the "TankTrouble in 3D" Blender model by asger-finding (CC0 1.0), with the camouflage material, lighting, effect artwork and build tooling by Bleed.
